description: This file contains functions and type definitions for probing and interacting with Discord's API, including fetching application info, parsing tokens, and handling privileged intents.

methods.name: fetchDiscordApplicationMe
methods.description: Fetches the Discord application info for the bot using the provided token.

methods.name: fetchDiscordApplicationMeResponse
methods.description: Sends a request to Discord API to get application info, with token normalization and timeout.

methods.name: resolveDiscordPrivilegedIntentsFromFlags
methods.description: Resolves privileged intents statuses from bit flags.

methods.name: fetchDiscordApplicationSummary
methods.description: Fetches a summary of the Discord application including ID, flags, and intents.

methods.name: getResolvedFetch
methods.description: Resolves the fetch implementation, throwing if unavailable.

methods.name: probeDiscord
methods.description: Probes Discord API with a token to retrieve user and application info, handling errors and timing.

methods.name: parseApplicationIdFromToken
methods.description: Extracts the application ID from a Discord bot token by decoding its first segment.

methods.name: fetchDiscordApplicationId
methods.description: Fetches the application ID from Discord API or falls back to token parsing.
